verdict.rationale: Belvo is an API-first service, so it can be driven headlessly. The docs cover API keys and a programmatic REST flow, a sandbox environment for testing the full API, asynchronous POST workflows, registrable webhooks, and pagination for automated data pulls. However, nothing documents running it in CI or offers headless-specific tooling, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard machine-readable paths. Missing for 10: CI/CD integration guidance, an official CLI or SDK for scripted automation, a machine-fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on reports of headless or CI use.
